=== data directives and strings
db 1, 2, 0xff, -1
dw 0x1234, 'ab', 'a'
dd 0x12345678, 'abcde', "xy"
dq 1, -2
db 'hello', 0, "world", 10
db `a\n\t\x41\101\\\``
dw "abc"
=== equ and local labels
base:
.x: db 1
foo equ 3
.y: db 2
dw base.x, base.y, foo
other:
.x: db 3
dw .x, base.x
=== single-line macros
%define twice(x) ((x)*2)
%define ONE 1
%define TWO ONE+ONE
db twice(3), TWO, twice(TWO)
%xdefine THREE TWO+ONE
%undef ONE
%define ONE 10
db THREE
%idefine loud 5
db LOUD, Loud
=== assign and rep
%assign i 0
%rep 4
db i
%assign i i+1
%endrep
%rep 10
%if i == 7
%exitrep
%endif
db i
%assign i i+1
%endrep
=== multi-line macro parameters and defaults
%macro m 1-3 7, 8
db %0, %1, %2, %3
%endmacro
m 1
m 1, 2
lab: m 3
%macro n 0-1
db %0
%endmacro
lab2 n
lab3: n 5
dw lab, lab2, lab3
=== macro label capture
%macro here 0
%00: db 0x42
%endmacro
spot here
dw spot
=== greedy parameters and rotate
%macro bytes 1+
db %1
%endmacro
bytes 1, 2, 3
%macro rev 1-*
%rep %0
%rotate -1
db %1
%endrep
%endmacro
rev 1, 2, 3, 4
%macro wrap 2+
db %1
db %2
%endmacro
wrap 9, 8, 7
=== macro local labels and pasting
%macro loopit 1
%%top: db %1
dw %%top
%endmacro
loopit 1
loopit 2
%macro mk 1
lbl_%1: db 0
val%{1}x equ 5
%endmacro
mk a
mk b
dw lbl_a, lbl_b, valax
=== braces in macro arguments
%macro two 2
db %1
db %2
%endmacro
two {1, 2}, 3
=== conditionals
%define X 1
%ifdef X
db 1
%else
db 2
%endif
%ifndef Y
db 3
%endif
%if X > 0 && 2 == 2
db 4
%elif 1
db 5
%endif
%if 0
db 6
%elif X
db 7
%else
db 8
%endif
%ifidn foo, foo
db 9
%endif
%ifidni FOO, foo
db 10
%endif
%ifnum 42
db 11
%endif
%ifstr 'x'
db 12
%endif
%ifid abc
db 13
%endif
%ifempty
db 14
%endif
%macro mac 1
%endmacro
%ifmacro mac
db 15
%endif
%ifnmacro nomac
db 16
%endif
%if 0
%if 1
db 17
%endif
%else
db 18
%endif
=== contexts
%push outer
%define %$v 1
%push inner
%define %$v 2
db %$v, %$$v
%pop
db %$v
%pop
%macro ctxlabel 0
%push ctx
jmp %$done
db 0
%$done:
%pop
%endmacro
=== strings in the preprocessor
%strlen len 'hello'
db len
%substr ch 'hello' 2
db ch
%substr part 'hello' 2, 3
db part
%defstr s abc
db s
%strcat both 'ab', "cd"
db both
=== struc and istruc
struc point
.x: resd 1
.y: resw 1
.z: resb 1
endstruc
dd point.x, point.y, point.z, point_size
pt: istruc point
at point.x, dd 1
at point.z, db 2
iend
db 0xee
=== align in data
db 1
align 4
db 2
align 8, db 0
db 3
alignb 4
db 4
=== times with dollar
db 1, 2, 3
times 8-($-$$) db 0x90
times 3 dw $
db 'x'
=== expression operators
db 7 / 2, -7 // 2, 7 % 3, -7 %% 3
db 1 << 3, 0x80 >> 3
dw -16 >>> 2
db 1 | 2 == 3
db (1 < 2) + (2 <= 2) + (3 > 2) + (3 >= 4) + (1 != 2) + (1 <> 1)
db 1 && 0, 1 || 0, 1 ^^ 1, !0, ~0 & 0xff
db 5 <=> 3, 3 <=> 5
=== numbers
db 0ffh, $0f, 0xf, 0h1f, 17q, 17o, 0o17, 0q17, 1010b, 0b1010, 0y11, 11y, 99d, 0d99, 0t12
dw 1_000
=== include files
%include "defs.inc"
db VALUE
incbin "blob.bin"
incbin "blob.bin", 1, 2
--- file defs.inc
%define VALUE 0x33
--- file blob.bin
ABCDEF
